text.p: The Coca-Cola Co. on Tuesday unveiled a new aluminium can that mimics the shape of its famous contoured bottle.

The soft-drink giant said the long-awaited packaging innovation, which it hopes will distinguish its canned products from those of its rivals, will be test-marketed in five U.S. markets early next month.
The new can will be introduced for the Coca-Cola Classic brand in four Southwestern markets and in Terre Haute, Indiana -- where the contoured bottle first appeared in 1915.
"The proprietary Coca-Cola contour bottle is one of the world's most powerful equities with consumers," Coca-Cola USA President Jack Stahl said in a statement.

"We view the introduction of the contour can as a learning opportunity to assess operational factors before we consider moving toward commercialization of the package. We want to see how the contour can actually works in the marketplace."
